subject: tuskroot

reference_provenance.subject: tuskroot
reference_provenance.prompt: Draft an original Tetherbound Tuskroot 3D modeling reference using the supplied established front crop and full installed-model render as species identity references. ONE complete three-quarter studio view of the same massive mature earth boar: broad warm brown face, blunt dark rounded snout with two readable nostrils, large expressive brown eyes, thick angular brows, small upright ears, two stout forward and upward curving ivory tusks, heavy barrel body, short strong four-legged stance, large dark hooves with warm tan claws, layered rough grey stone plates embedded along the back with restrained moss and broad natural green leaves. It is Mudsnout grown up, not a new species: keep the established brown, grey, moss-green and ivory colour organization, rounded friendly face underneath its powerful brow, complete boar anatomy and large adult mass. Neutral riggable pose: all FOUR full legs and complete hooves visibly separate beneath the body, front and rear limb roots clear, no crouching or tucked limbs, each sole on the floor, broad solid torso with a natural supported neck and readable shoulders, both tusks entirely visible. A small complete boar tail may follow the installed anatomy, no invented giant tail or extra appendage. Consolidate moss/leaves into a few broad connected masses on the coherent stone mantle; no thin dangling roots, wire leaves, scattered stones or floating fragments. Sculpt the face and brow cleanly with soft roughness and large readable surfaces; preserve the identity rather than adding scars, horns or armour. Whole head, tusks, four feet and back inside frame with generous margin. Plain light-grey studio floor, soft neutral light, stylized detailed game-creature surface. No glowing eyes, lava, neon, metallic sheen, red faction colours, equipment, saddle, harness, weapons, humans, text, ruler, board, environment or action pose. One existing roster creature only.

inspection.identity: Established heavy brown boar, dark blunt nose, expressive brown eyes, ivory tusks, rough grey stone back and natural moss/leaf masses retained
inspection.riggability: Four visibly separate complete feet, clear adult boar torso and neck, both tusks fully visible, broad connected foliage rather than thin roots
inspection.limits: Leaf/stone attachment topology, foot segmentation, tusk protection, saddle contact and new colour variants require generated/native inspection; no full art pass from the reference.

rights.basis: Owner-held installed identity and original drafted reference; owner-authorized paid Meshy account. No purchase or community publication.

preparation.approach: Measured boar torso, four feet and three short tail segments; protected back mantle, local surface diffusion and normalized four influences.
preparation.material: Organic dielectric: metallic and emission disabled, UVs and texture maps retained
